subject: Marketplace co-sell: role assignments and cross-region bridge
messages:
From: Sean O'Neil <sean@cloudbridge.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace co-sell: intro + initial date options

Hi Mateo (and team),

Thanks again for the intro last week. LuminaHealth is excited to see Redwood integrated into our CloudBridge SI workflow — they'd like a joint marketplace co-sell demo that covers: brief product overview, a technical deep-dive on private deploy options, and the AWS Marketplace packaging/offerings.

Could you do one of these windows next week (PST times):
- Tue 26 May, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 27 May, 14:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 28 May, 08:00–09:00 PT (for APAC-friendly slot)

Also: who would you want to present each segment on Redwood's side (product + technical + marketplace packaging)? We can bring our SI lead (me) and the Lumina procurement/contact (Alicia Wang).

Attaching a short draft agenda. Let me know which slot works and who is primary/backup.

Attachments: CB_Lumina_agenda_v0.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Sean
Senior Partnerships, CloudBridge
sean@cloudbridge.io

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean O'Neil <sean@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: intro + initial date options

Hi Sean — great to meet you.

We can cover all three segments. Proposed Redwood roles:
- Product overview: Mateo Alvarez (me) — 10m
- Technical deep-dive (private/VPC/on-prem): Karthik Iyer — 25m
- Marketplace packaging & go-to-market notes: Ben Carter — 15m
- Q&A / next steps: Vanessa Ortiz (facilitator) — 10m

From Redwood's side, our preferred slot is Tue 26 May 10:00 PT. If that doesn't work for Lumina, Wed 27 May 14:00 PT is acceptable. Vanessa/Karthik — can you confirm availability and whether you want a 30–45m internal rehearsal prior to the demo (we typically do 30m run-through)?

I'll loop in AWS Marketplace once we lock the time — Sean, do you already have the AWS contact or should we ping our marketplace rep?

Best,
Mateo
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 12:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: intro + initial date options

Mateo / Karthik — I can take facilitator duties and own the run-of-show and gating items. Confirming availability for the Tue 26 May 10:00 PT slot; I can be primary facilitator and backup host. Ben, can you cover the marketplace packaging piece?

Quick checklist I'm preparing (sending as attachment):
- Confirm AWS Marketplace rep and confirm licensing questions to prep
- Shared slides + redwood demo env access for Lumina (test accounts)
- Rehearsal: Wed 25 May, 08:00 PT (30m) — propose this so Karthik has time to validate VPC demo scripts
- Fallback host: Vanessa Ortiz; secondary fallback: Mateo

Attaching: marketplace-demo-checklist.pdf (2 pages)

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Solutions Lead, Partnerships
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: intro + initial date options

Thanks — I can take the technical deep-dive. Rehearsal Wed 25 May 08:00 PT works for me. Couple of notes for the runbook:
- I'll demo private deployment (VPC peering flow) and an example quantized model load — need 1 GPU host with preloaded model; Vanessa / Mateo, can you confirm a test token and the demo tenant?
- Timeboxed fallback: if network flakiness occurs, switch to recorded screen share (I will pre-record the model load snippet).
- Ask AWS rep to confirm Marketplace listing visibility across regions (US/EU) during the meeting so procurement can ask specifics.

I'll attach a first-pass runbook doc and link to the demo credentials in Drive.

Regards,
Karthik
Principal Engineer, Applied ML
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Sean O'Neil <sean@cloudbridge.io>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alicia Wang <alicia@luminahealth.com>, AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell: intro + initial date options

Mateo — Tue 26 May 10:00 PT works for Lumina. Alicia (Lumina) has accepted the preliminary agenda. I've also added our AWS Marketplace contact (aws-marketplace@amazon.com) to confirm region visibility.

A few asks from Lumina ahead of the demo:
- Procurement will want a clear line item for Marketplace licensing and any reserved capacity (if dedicated).
- They'd like to see a short SLA summary (uptime, support tiers) and a pointer to SOC2 / compliance docs.

Can Redwood provide the SLA bullets and SOC2 link in advance? If yes, we'll circulate to procurement to make the demo an executive-level meeting.

Thanks,
Sean

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Tue 26 May, 10:00–11:00 PT. Calendar invite will go out from my calendar (attached). Final role assignments below:

- Facilitator / host: Vanessa Ortiz (run-of-show, recordings)
- Product overview: Mateo Alvarez (10m)
- Technical deep-dive: Karthik Iyer (25m) — includes VPC demo + pre-recorded fallback
- Marketplace packaging & GTM notes: Ben Carter (15m)
- Procurement / SLA bullets: Mateo (5m)

Pre-reads attached: runbook-v1.docx, marketplace-demo-checklist.pdf. Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Axyz/runbook-v1 and HubSpot deal DB-7391.

Vanessa — please send the rehearsal invite for Wed 25 May 08:00 PT and include a quick checklist for Zoom hosts (recording, breakout, participant pinning).

Attachments: runbook-v1.docx (4 pages), marketplace-demo-checklist.pdf (2 pages), calendar-invite.ics

Best,
